notes.title: Update to Version 19
notes.content:
- changed the background color for the chat to increase readability
- decreased scroll view size, to ensure that the Bohn-O-Meter of each card stack is readable
- The Bohn-O-Meter at the bottom of the card stack now highlights the reward for harvesting
- discarding Bohnuscards now skips automatically when there are no Bohnus Cards to discard
- the local player can no longer be removed from local games
- the confirm move button is no longer active during Bohnuscard completion
- fixed a logic bug where you could prematurely end the gifting phase and put the game in a stuck state. Affected local games are sadly lost, online game affected must load without replay to be able to continue
